observations: Photo 0 shows two silver laptops in a 2-in-1 mode: one folded into a tablet position, the other open as a laptop. The screen displays a Windows desktop with a pier wallpaper. The HP logo is visible on the lower bezel of the screen.

Photo 1 shows the same setup from a different angle. The left laptop is in tent mode, screen visible. The right laptop is open, showing the keyboard and trackpad. The HP logo is visible on the lower bezel.

Photo 2 shows both laptops with screens off. The left laptop is open, showing the keyboard and trackpad. The right laptop is in tent mode. The HP logo is visible on the lower bezel of both screens. The keyboard has a small fingerprint sensor icon near the bottom right corner.
All three photos show the same two laptops, suggesting the item is being sold as a pair or one is a prop. The seller's text describes a single laptop.
The laptops appear to be identical in design, with silver chassis, black keys, and a large trackpad. The hinge allows 360-degree rotation, consistent with a 2-in-1 convertible.
No model number or serial number is visible on any part of the laptops in the photos.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JUL GADGETBAY' is present on all photos, indicating a listing platform.

claims.evidence: The HP logo is visible, but no model number is readable in any photo. The design matches the EliteBook x360 830 G7, but cannot be confirmed without a visible model tag or serial number.
No system information or BIOS screen is visible. The CPU cannot be confirmed from the photos alone.
No system information or disk management screen is visible. RAM and SSD specs cannot be confirmed from the photos.
Photo 2 shows a fingerprint sensor icon near the bottom right of the keyboard. The presence of a front-facing camera (visible in photo 0) supports Face ID claim, though not confirmed as active.
